why: form_key gender label should match noun.gender 'common' as in the other common-gender nouns
in today's news and legislation the word is used almost only in ευζωία των ζώων; lead with that sense

example.el: Η πυρκαγιά αποτέφρωσε χιλιάδες στρέμματα δασικής έκτασης.
example.en: The fire reduced thousands of stremmata of forest land to ashes.

why: a stremma is 1,000 m2 (about a quarter acre); 'thousands of acres' overstates the area

example.el: Από μικρός ήταν ασθενικός και έλειπε συχνά από το σχολείο.
example.en: Ever since he was little he was sickly and often missed school.

why: neuter ασθενικό agreeing with παιδί reads awkwardly for 'he'; the masculine with από μικρός is the natural phrasing

set.gloss: case fatality rate (share of patients who die of a disease); mortality, being mortal

example.el: Η θνητότητα από τη νόσο μειώθηκε σημαντικά μετά τους εμβολιασμούς.
example.en: The disease's case fatality rate fell significantly after the vaccinations.

why: in Greek health reporting θνητότητα is the case fatality rate, distinct from θνησιμότητα (mortality rate)

set.gloss: diversion, distraction (of public opinion, attention); disorientation

why: the political sense (αποπροσανατολισμός της κοινής γνώμης) is the most frequent one in news

example.el: Ο νεαρός δεξιοτέχνης του βιολιού καταχειροκροτήθηκε στο Μέγαρο Μουσικής.
example.en: The young violin virtuoso was given a rousing ovation at the Megaron concert hall.

why: καταχειροκροτήθηκε means he was warmly applauded; it does not say the audience stood
